BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to pain management; adding new sections to chapter18.130 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.130 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By November 15, 2010, the secretary shall, by rule, developcriteria for approving pain management education programs for purposesof section 2 of this act. (2) Annually, beginning January 1, 2011, the secretary shall usethe criteria developed under subsection (1) of this section to publisha list of approved pain management education programs.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.130 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A license holder who is authorized by law to prescribe a ScheduleII controlled substance shall complete one pain management educationprogram approved by the secretary under section 1 of this act as partof his or her continuing education requirements. The license holdershall complete the education program: p. 1 HB 2876 (1) Within twentyfour months of the effective date of this sectionif the license holder was licensed prior to the effective date of thissection; or (2) Prior to renewing his or her license if the license holder waslicensed on or after the effective date of this section.
Section 2 of this act takes effect January1, 2011.
